list.title: Tours
list.description: Your journeys as they appear on the site. Drag to set the order of the tours page, switch to publish or hide.
list.dragHint: Drag the handles (or focus one and use ↑ ↓) to reorder
list.reorderDisabled: Reordering is off while a search or status filter is active — clear the filters to drag tours into order.
list.reorderTooMany: There are more than {max} tours, so drag-to-reorder is turned off.
list.noMatchesBody: Try another search term or status.
list.emptyBody: Create the first journey — it stays a draft until you publish it.
list.duration: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}
list.viewOnSite: View “{title}” on the site (opens in a new tab)
list.orderFailed: The new order couldn't be saved
list.publishedToast: “{title}” is now live on the site
list.unpublishedToast: “{title}” is now a draft and hidden from the site
list.deleteBody: The tour, its itinerary days and gallery links are removed permanently. Media files stay in the library.
list.deleteBodyPublished: This tour is live. Deleting it removes the page from the site and permanently deletes its itinerary and gallery links. Media files stay in the library.

editor.newDescription: Fill in the English version first — translations can follow. New tours are saved as drafts until you publish them.
editor.editingLocale: Editing the {language} version. Empty fields show the English text as a hint and fall back to English on the site.
editor.previewLabel: View this tour on the site (opens in a new tab)
editor.previewUnavailable: Publish the tour to view it on the site
editor.duplicatingFrom: Creating a draft copy of “{title}”. Review the slug and title, then save.
editor.duplicateLoadFailed: The source tour couldn't be loaded for duplication.
editor.discardBody: Your edits since the last save will be lost and the form will revert to the saved tour.
editor.publishIncompleteBody: This tour is still missing: {missing}. You can publish anyway or finish those sections first.
editor.slugTaken: Another tour already uses this URL slug.
editor.slugTakenToast: This URL slug is already in use
editor.savedPublished: Saved and published — the tour is live
editor.published: Published — the tour is live on the site
editor.unpublished: Unpublished — the tour is hidden from the site
editor.deleteBody: The tour, its itinerary days and gallery links are removed permanently. Media files stay in the library.
editor.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to pick another tour.

validation.slug: Use at least 2 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (e.g. cultural-odyssey).

list.notTranslated: No {language} version yet — the site shows the {count, plural, one {English item} other {# English items}}. Copy them to translate, or start an empty list.

details.basicsHint: Title, address and the short texts used on tour cards.
details.summaryHint: One or two sentences for tour cards and search results.
details.cardTagHint: Small label on the tour card, e.g. “Chauffeur Guide”.
details.routeSummaryHint: Shown with the route, e.g. “745 Kilometers · 3 Distinct Climate Zones”.
details.descriptionHint: The long introduction on the tour page (Markdown).
details.overviewHint: The “expedition philosophy” block on the tour page — kicker, heading and a quote.
details.routePlaceholder: Add a place, e.g. Sigiriya & Dambulla
details.routeHint: Place names in travel order — shared by all languages.
details.highlightsHint: Up to 12 short highlights shown on cards and the tour page.
details.badgesHint: Up to 8 short badges, e.g. “UNESCO World Heritage”.
details.keyFeaturesHint: Up to 8 icon tiles summarising the journey.
details.inclusionsHint: What the journey covers — each line with an icon.
details.terrainsHint: Up to 6 climate or landscape zones the route passes through.
details.durationMismatch: The itinerary has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} but the duration is {duration, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
details.featuredHint: Shown in the featured spots on the home page.
details.mostPopularHint: Adds the “Most popular” ribbon on cards.
details.seasonsHint: Used by the tour filters and the trip-finder quiz.

itinerary.title: Itinerary
itinerary.description: Drag days into order — day numbers follow automatically. Each day's text is edited in the language selected above.
itinerary.dayCount: {count, plural, =0 {No days} one {# day} other {# days}}
itinerary.mismatch: The itinerary has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, but the tour duration is set to {duration, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
itinerary.syncDuration: Set duration to {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
itinerary.generateDays: Generate {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from duration
itinerary.addRemainingDays: Add {count, plural, one {1 remaining day} other {# remaining days}}
itinerary.empty: No days yet — add the first day of the journey.
itinerary.highlightHint: Emphasises this day on the tour page.
itinerary.stopsEmpty: No map stops for this day.
itinerary.stopsHint: Stops draw the route on the tour map. Tip: in Google Maps, right-click a place and click the coordinates to copy “lat, lng”.

gallery.coverHint: Shown on tour cards and as the hero image of the tour page.
gallery.galleryHint: Drag to reorder. Title and caption are edited in the language selected above.

destinations.selectedHint: Shown on the tour page in this order.
destinations.noneSelected: No destinations yet — add them from the list.
destinations.allHint: Click a destination to add or remove it.
destinations.full: The maximum of {max} destinations is reached.
destinations.results: {count, plural, =0 {No destinations} one {# destination} other {# destinations}}

seo.title: Search engines
seo.description: Title and description shown by Google and when the page is shared.
seo.titleFallbackEmpty: Leave empty to use the tour title with its duration.
seo.descriptionFallback: Leave empty to use the start of the summary.
seo.previewHint: Roughly how Google shows the page. Long texts are cut off.
seo.noDescription: Add a summary or SEO description
seo.usingTitleFallback: Using the automatic title (tour title + duration).
seo.usingDescriptionFallback: Using the start of the summary.

categories.title: Tour categories
categories.description: The travel styles that group tours on the site (filters, home page tiles). Drag to set their order.
categories.count: {count, plural, =0 {No categories} one {# category} other {# categories}}
categories.dragHint: Drag the handles (or focus one and use ↑ ↓) to reorder
categories.emptyBody: Categories group tours into travel styles such as Wildlife or Honeymoon.
categories.tourCountTitle: Tours linked to this category (any status)
categories.tourCount: {count, plural, =0 {No tours} one {# tour} other {# tours}}
categories.orderFailed: The new order couldn't be saved
categories.deleteBodyLinked: {count, plural, one {# tour uses} other {# tours use}} this category. The tours stay, but they lose this category.
categories.shortNameHint: Short label for filter chips. Falls back to the name.
categories.kickerHint: Small line above the name on category tiles, e.g. “Heritage & Monasteries”.
categories.iconHint: Shown on filter chips and tiles.
categories.imageHint: Photo of the category tile on the home page.
categories.linkedTours: {count, plural, =0 {No tours use this category yet.} one {# tour uses this category.} other {# tours use this category.}}
categories.slugTaken: Another category already uses this slug.
categories.slugTakenToast: This slug is already in use
